api_docs_intro: Generate 800×480 BMP images for E-Ink displays showing F1 race schedules in 1bit, B/W/R, B/W/R/Y, or Spectra 6 mode.
api_docs_selection_note: Without year plus round or race_key, the next race is selected. Copy round or race_key from /api/races/{year}. Exception: race_key without year returns HTTP 400.
api_docs_etag_note: BMP responses include ETag. Send If-None-Match to receive 304 when the image is unchanged.
api_docs_operational_auth: Statistics read APIs require X-Admin-Token or Authorization: Bearer <token> when ADMIN_API_TOKEN is configured. With MINIMAL_DATA_MODE=true, all statistics APIs return 410.
api_docs_perf_desc: GET: performance summaries; hours: 1–720 (default 24). POST: numeric Web Vitals; visitor and device metadata are ignored.
api_docs_readiness_desc: Database, writable storage and image freshness; HTTP 200 when ready, 503 otherwise.
api_docs_preview_desc: PNG previews for calendar or teams; lang selects the language. Configure previews also accept display and calendar weather_type (default off).
api_docs_eink_desc: Fetch /calendar.bmp and display directly on your E-Ink display. Recommended refresh interval: every 1-6 hours. Compatible with any 800×480 E-Ink display (e.g., Waveshare 7.5", LaskaKit).
api_docs_teams_desc: Generate a BMP image showing all F1 teams with their drivers, photos, and championship points in 1bit, B/W/R, B/W/R/Y, or Spectra 6 output modes.
api_docs_teams_json_desc: Get all teams with drivers and points for a season (JSON)
api_docs_standings_leader_desc: Get current championship leaders (driver and constructor)
stats_track_legacy_note: legacy marks older requests whose map choices were not recorded.

privacy_intro_text: F1.InkyCloud.click is a public noncommercial service without accounts, advertising or payments.
privacy_data_text: The default configuration keeps operating totals, without individual visitor records:
privacy_data_usage: Usage: hourly request counts and response totals by public settings. No IP address, User-Agent, referrer or visitor identifier is stored. Retention: {retention} days.
privacy_data_webvitals: Performance: a random {sample}% sample of page loads sends numeric Web Vitals once. Only hourly histograms remain, rounded to 50 ms and 0.01 CLS. Retention: {perf_retention} days. These are approximate performance statistics, not unique visitor counts.
privacy_data_errors: Errors: when configured, GlitchTip receives scrubbed error types and code stack locations, without request bodies, user details, breadcrumbs, local variables, tracing or profiling. Application and access logs are disabled in the application container in the default profile; the hosting proxy's access logs are described under Retention.
privacy_data_local: Preferences: when you choose a language with the switcher, it is saved in localStorage (until you clear site data) and in a functional cookie for 30 days. The browser detects the time zone. Selected settings are sent in the URL to generate your image. Clear browser site data to remove the preference.
privacy_thirdparty_text: Processors: Hetzner Online GmbH (servers, Germany); coolLabs Solutions Kft. – Coolify Cloud (server management, Hungary); Cloudflare, Inc. (DNS and forwarding of privacy@ e-mail; EU-US Data Privacy Framework). E-mails to the privacy contact are forwarded to a Gmail mailbox, so Google LLC (USA, EU-US Data Privacy Framework) is a recipient of them. These e-mails are used only to handle your request – on the basis of Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR for requests under the GDPR and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for other enquiries – and are deleted {mail_days} days after the request is closed. Optional GlitchTip receives scrubbed errors. Credits show which integrations are active.
privacy_gdpr_text: Reducing collection does not remove all GDPR obligations. The sections below name the controller, legal basis, retention periods and your rights.
privacy_controller_name_missing: TODO: controller name not yet provided
privacy_controller_email_missing: TODO: contact e-mail not yet provided
privacy_basis_text: Processing relies on legitimate interest under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our interest is operating a secure, reliable free service and visitor statistics (aggregate measurement of site usage).
privacy_basis_delivery: Delivering the service: your IP address and HTTP headers are received to send each response and are not written to storage by the application. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_visitor_stats: Purpose: visitor statistics (aggregate proxy-level measurement of site usage). Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_security_shared: Security and rate limiting: one shared request counter per rate-limit bucket, without IP addresses. Counters are kept only in memory, expire about 60 seconds after the last counted request and are never written to disk. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_security_ip: Security and rate limiting: request counters keyed by IP address. Counters are kept only in memory, expire about 60 seconds after the last counted request and are never written to disk. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_stats: Purpose: visitor statistics. Aggregate statistics: hourly usage counts and sampled Web Vitals histograms without visitor identifiers. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_stats_raw: Purpose: visitor statistics. Usage statistics: individual API request records and individual sampled performance measurements, without IP addresses or visitor identifiers, kept for the raw-record period in the Retention section; request records then remain only as hourly totals and performance measurements are deleted. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_errors: Error monitoring: scrubbed GlitchTip error events without request data or user details. Art. 6(1)(f).
privacy_basis_language: Language preference: a functional cookie and localStorage entry are set only when you choose a language with the switcher. They only provide the language you requested. Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; storage exempt under §89(3) of the Czech Electronic Communications Act (ZEK).
privacy_retention_ratelimit: Rate-limit counters: kept only in memory, expire about 60 seconds after the last counted request, never written to disk.
privacy_retention_proxy: The hosting proxy (Traefik) keeps access logs with the full IP address, time, URL path, User-Agent and Referer for at most {proxy_days} days. Coolify Sentinel uses the path, User-Agent and Referer to keep aggregate visitor statistics (path, browser, operating system, device type, referrer, country and city via local GeoIP; IP shortened to /24 or /48): hourly for {hourly_days} days, daily for {daily_days} days. The application container writes no access log.
privacy_retention_raw: Individual request records without IP addresses or identifiers (only when aggregate-only mode is disabled): deleted after {days} days. Before deletion they are merged into hourly totals only if they are still within the hourly-totals retention period.
privacy_retention_perf_raw: Individual performance measurements without IP addresses or identifiers: deleted after {days} days. They are not merged into totals.
privacy_retention_errors_operator: Error events: retention is set by the operator of the monitoring service.
privacy_retention_language: Language cookie: 30 days. The localStorage entry stays until you clear site data.
privacy_rights_text: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
privacy_rights_objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21)
privacy_rights_complaint: lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority; in the Czech Republic this is the Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ):
privacy_rights_identification: No visitor identifiers are stored, so the operator may be unable to identify data relating to you (Art. 11 GDPR). Articles 15 to 20 then apply only if you provide additional information that enables identification. Within {proxy_days} days, a request can be looked up in the proxy logs if you give your IP address and the approximate time of your visit.
privacy_rights_contact: To exercise your rights, contact the controller at the e-mail address in the Data Controller section.
privacy_opensource_text: The application code is under the MIT licence. Maps, data and fonts have separate rights described in Credits.
privacy_contact_text: For privacy requests, write to {contact}. Do not publish personal data in GitHub issues.

credits_page.logos: Team names and colours are used only to identify teams; no team logos are shown. This does not imply any partnership or endorsement.
